title: Marketing Operations Associate - Funnel/Landing Page Builder
subtitle: About PATI Group
body:
## About PATI Group

PATI is a fast-growing E-commerce business specializing in dietary supplements, achieving a remarkable 500% increase in sales within just one year in the United States market. We're on a mission to become the leading dietary supplement company in Vietnam by 2026, offering innovative and high-quality products that inspire our customers to optimize their physical, mental, and intellectual potential.

As we continue our rapid growth trajectory, we're seeking a visionary **Marketing Operations Associate** to lead our marketing efforts and drive us towards these goals.

## Job Summary

Are you a tech-savvy marketer with a knack for design and a passion for creating high-converting digital experiences? As our **Marketing Operations Associate**, you will collaborate with the Line Manager to drive the success of our supplement brands. You will be **instrumental in designing, implementing, and optimizing our marketing operations on Shopify - focusing on landing pages and funnels** - to ensure efficient campaign execution and the achievement of our business goals.

## **Essential Roles and Responsibilities**

- **Campaign Management**: Setup, implement, and manage Meta or AppLovin Ads campaigns to drive brand awareness, engagement, and conversions.

- **Performance Analysis**: Monitor and analyze campaign performance, providing detailed reports and insights to optimize and improve results.

- **Creative Collaboration**: Work closely with the creative team to develop compelling ad creatives and copy that resonate with our audience.

- **Technical Savvy: **Quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and tools that enhance marketing efforts on Shopify platform. Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to marketing operations.

- **Communication and Collaboration: **Excellent communication and project management skills. Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to align marketing operations with business objectives.

- **Adaptability and Continuous Learning: **Stay updated on industry trends and emerging marketing platforms. Demonstrate the ability to learn swiftly and apply new knowledge to ongoing projects.

## **Skills and Qualifications**

- **At least 2 years of experience **in developing landing pages and marketing funnels, or significant hands-on experience with Shopify.

- **Fluent in English communication** (written and spoken), with an IELTS score above 7.0 or equivalent.

- **Strong leadership skills**, with proven ability to enhance team performance; candidates should provide evidence of past achievements.

- **Proactive learning behavior**, dedicated to daily learning and sharing knowledge that immediately supports work objectives.

- **Positive, “can-do” attitude** with a passion for driving results.

- **Alignment with our core values**: Honor Our Words, Play Like A Teamsport, and Foster Innovation. Visit [patigroup.com](http://patigroup.com) to learn more; please provide proof of how you embody these values.

## **Come join PATI, you will have a chance to enjoy**

- 10.000.000 VND - 15.000.000 VND + incentive based on performance (negotiate). Total income can be up to 25.000.000 VND.

- Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic Global E-commerce environment.

- To fully enjoy other social welfare regimes such as social insurance, statutory leave,...

- Joining various team bonding activities.

We are looking for someone who shares our passion for wellness, our commitment to excellence, and our dedication to making a positive impact on our customers' lives. If you believe you have the skills and mindset to thrive in this role, we want to hear from you.

Company Address: 152 Dien Bien Phu Street, Ward 25, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City

**🚀 APPLY [HERE](https://paticreativeagency.larksuite.com/share/base/form/shrusjCC2CJeEWBc1wNKIX7fibc)**
